source.title: Surveyor VII Mission Report, Part I: Mission Description and Performance

transit.bcr_efficiency_evidence: Estimated in flight; not directly measured. Do not classify as measured calibration.

surface_operations.qualification: Generally ahead of Sun for charging control and equipment shade; fully sun-oriented only in the final 24 hours of the first lunar day. No per-epoch articulation history transcribed.

sunset.qualification: Camera sunlight loss and panel zero output are different observables. No historical terrain/pose replay has been validated.

missing_for_vehicle_prediction: Verified dimensional mesh and per-component transforms
Cell I-V and temperature calibration with operating conditions
Thermal capacities, conductances and radiative view factors
Machine-readable telemetry with calibration and uncertainty
Local surface radiometry and component-height terrain masks
